rca_of_issue: Likely frontend state/race issue around ready orders query hydration: component shows isLoading spinner with zero count even when backend logs show successful 200 ready-orders responses. Reproduction: repeated auth transitions owner→pegawai and rapid tab navigation to Siap Diambil. Mitigation: instrument react-query status transitions for ['ready-orders', outletId], verify outletId/session reset on login/logout, and ensure loading state exits on resolved empty/non-empty responses.
